name: QC Design
description: QC Design is a German quantum software company developing design-automation software and fault-tolerant architectures for quantum hardware manufacturers. Its Plaquette platform simulates and engineers logical qubits and error-correction schemes under realistic hardware imperfections, and is used by hardware developers including QUDORA and C12. The company was co-founded by Ish Dhand and Martin Plenio and is based in Ulm.
